'''Jonathan Torres''' (also published as '''Jon Torres''')<ref name="dt-17976">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/17976 Ernie's SYCFA], DeckTech (Jonathan "Ernie15079" Torres, 31 July 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/17976/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/17976/ GitHub Pages].</ref> (DeckTech handle '''Ernie15079''') posted a [[Dark]] [[Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe|Set Your Course For Alderaan]] list on DeckTech in July 2001. He played northern New Jersey tournaments in 2000–2001.
